traditional: A 同 B 一齊 V 嘅
jyutping: A tung4 B jat1 cai4 V ge3

english.note: Use this all-purpose construction when saying that two or more people or organisations jointly carried out an action.

examples.english: The report was a joint effort by Ming and me.
examples.traditional: 我同阿明一齊整呢份報告嘅。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 ming4 jat1 cai4 zing2 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3
